capabilities: Sync items saved in the WeChat mini program or iOS Shortcut into the vault
Save video links and articles as notes with locally downloaded media and attachments
Transcribe videos and voice recordings on the server with paragraph and timestamp grouping
Insert optional AI summaries with key points, analogies, highlights and keywords
Organize notes into category and monthly folders, moving notes and attachments when AI reclassifies them
extras: Service is currently free (no payment required). Detailed privacy and server data-retention table is provided; the backend can be self-hosted via an advanced Server URL setting. Bilingual English/Chinese README; manual installation described.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to capture content saved on a phone through WeChat and turn it into vault notes with downloaded media, transcripts and AI summaries.

relations.evidence: The plugin only works together with the 易度随手存 (Yidu Suishoucun) WeChat mini program, which you sign in to with your WeChat account.
